from pydantic import BaseModel, Field
from typing import List, Optional

class RulingItem(BaseModel):
    """A specific clause or outcome from the judgment."""
    description: str = Field(description="Verbatim text of the ruling clause")
    amount: Optional[str] = Field(description="Monetary amount mentioned in the clause")
    payer: Optional[str] = Field(description="Party ordered to pay")
    payee: Optional[str] = Field(description="Party receiving payment")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Extracted information from a single judgment document."""
    document_label: List[str] = Field(description="Label identifying the document (e.g., 判决文书 1)")
    case_number: List[str] = Field(description="Official case number")
    case_type: List[str] = Field(description="Type of case and procedure (e.g., 民事二审)")
    parties: List[str] = Field(description="Names of all parties involved")
    outcome_keywords: List[str] = Field(description="Key phrases indicating the final result")
    ruling_items: List[RulingItem] = Field(description="Specific items in the judgment")
